biomarkers.name: PAX3/7-FOXO1 (alveolar RMS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Present in most fusion-positive alveolar rhabdomyosarcomas; uncommon in embryonal RMS

biomarkers.name: Histology-specific biomarkers
biomarkers.clinical_use: See SOFT_TISSUE_AND_BONE_SARCOMA section for RMS subtypes, other orbital sarcomas

biomarkers.name: NAB2-STAT6 (solitary fibrous tumour)
biomarkers.prevalence: Characteristic driver fusion in solitary fibrous tumour
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports diagnosis of solitary fibrous tumour of orbit; typically associated with STAT6 nuclear expression

biomarkers.name: HHV-8/KSHV (Kaposi sarcoma)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Required diagnostic association for Kaposi sarcoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Heterogeneous category — histology depends on tumour type
variants: embryonal or alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (most common paediatric orbital sarcoma)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Heterogeneous — depends on tumour type: rhabdomyoblastic (from primitive mesenchymal cells in orbit for RMS), fibroblastic (SFT), smooth muscle (LMS), endothelial/spindle cell lineage associated with HHV-8 infection (Kaposi)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: As per tumour type — see corresponding entries in SOFT_TISSUE_AND_BONE_SARCOMA for RMS subtypes and other sarcomas
